apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube 21.47.6 | YTKACE_21.47.6_1.1.9

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
#### A YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, iSponsorBlock, DeArrow, player controls, and interface customization.
> [!NOTE]
> - 📝[v1.1.9 release notes](https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.1.9)
> - 🔽Set Download Button to Both in settings to enable Downloads. 
> - 📺 Functional YT Cast 
> - 🔨 Full reinstall is recommended if there's glitches/black screens. 
> - 🆕 `YTLowContrastMode` tweak, enabled by default.
> - 📦 `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` and  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` are inside YTKACE
> - 🫧 Enable Liquid Glass in YTKACE settings.
>
> - - -
>
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTweaks` `YTLowContrastMode`
> -  `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `VolumeBoostYT`

> [!WARNING]
> -  21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
